title: Does your AI know what changed today?
description: We asked our local AI for the current date and latest FFmpeg release, then checked the release page ourselves.
ogDescription: Our local AI said it couldn't know today's date or the latest FFmpeg version. The release page had both in one line.
alt: Local AI reply saying it has no access to the current date, next to the FFmpeg 9.1 release listing
ctaLine: Recent question? Get the date and the link.
author: Nick
